651:     for (let i = this.spawnQueue.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
652:       const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1))
653:       ;[this.spawnQueue[i], this.spawnQueue[j]] = [this.spawnQueue[j], this.spawnQueue[i]]

705:   updatePlayer(dt) {
706:     const p = this.player
707:     const crouch = this.keys.has('ControlLeft') || this.keys.has('ControlRight') || this.keys.has('KeyC') || this.crouchToggle
708:     p.crouching = crouch
709:     const sprint = this.keys.has('ShiftLeft') || this.keys.has('ShiftRight')
710:     const ads = this.adsHeld || this.touchAds
711:     const wantSprint = sprint && !crouch && !ads && (this.keys.has('KeyW') || this.touchMove.y < -0.3)
712:     p.sprinting = wantSprint
713: 
714:     let f = (this.keys.has('KeyW') ? 1 : 0) - (this.keys.has('KeyS') ? 1 : 0) - this.touchMove.y
715:     let r = (this.keys.has('KeyD') ? 1 : 0) - (this.keys.has('KeyA') ? 1 : 0) + this.touchMove.x
716:     const len = Math.hypot(f, r)
717:     if (len > 1) { f /= len; r /= len }
718:     const sin = Math.sin(p.yaw), cos = Math.cos(p.yaw)
719:     const moveX = (-sin * f + cos * r)
720:     const moveZ = (-cos * f - sin * r)
721:     let targetSpeed = crouch ? 2.35 : wantSprint ? 7.4 : 4.7
722:     if (ads) targetSpeed *= 0.62
723:     const accel = p.grounded ? 14 : 3.2
724:     p.vel.x = damp(p.vel.x, moveX * targetSpeed, accel, dt)
725:     p.vel.z = damp(p.vel.z, moveZ * targetSpeed, accel, dt)
726:     if (Math.abs(moveX) < 0.01 && Math.abs(moveZ) < 0.01) {
727:       p.vel.x = damp(p.vel.x, 0, p.grounded ? 13 : 0.8, dt)
728:       p.vel.z = damp(p.vel.z, 0, p.grounded ? 13 : 0.8, dt)
729:     }
730: 
731:     p.crouchAmount = damp(p.crouchAmount, crouch ? 1 : 0, 12, dt)
732:     const height = lerp(1.8, 1.24, p.crouchAmount)
733:     const eyeTarget = lerp(1.62, 1.06, p.crouchAmount)
734:     p.height = height
735: 
736:     if (this.jumpQueued) {
737:       this.jumpQueued = false
738:       if (p.grounded && !crouch) { p.vel.y = 5.5; p.grounded = false }
739:     }
740:     this.jumpQueued = false
741: 
742:     const radius = p.radius
743:     const feet = p.pos.y
744:     const tryX = p.pos.x + p.vel.x * dt
745:     if (tryX > ARENA.minX + radius && tryX < ARENA.maxX - radius) {
746:       const gh = this.world.groundHeightAt(tryX, p.pos.z)
747:       if (gh <= feet + 0.52 && !this.world.colliderAt(tryX, p.pos.z, radius, feet, height)) p.pos.x = tryX
748:       else p.vel.x = 0
749:     } else p.vel.x = 0
750:     const tryZ = p.pos.z + p.vel.z * dt
751:     if (tryZ > ARENA.minZ + radius && tryZ < ARENA.maxZ - radius) {
752:       const gh = this.world.groundHeightAt(p.pos.x, tryZ)
753:       if (gh <= feet + 0.52 && !this.world.colliderAt(p.pos.x, tryZ, radius, feet, height)) p.pos.z = tryZ
754:       else p.vel.z = 0
755:     } else p.vel.z = 0
756: 
757:     // vertical
758:     p.vel.y -= 18.5 * dt
759:     p.pos.y += p.vel.y * dt
760:     const gh = this.world.groundHeightAt(p.pos.x, p.pos.z)
761:     if (p.pos.y <= gh) {
762:       if (!p.grounded && p.vel.y < -4) { this.landKick = 1; this.effects.shake = Math.max(this.effects.shake, 0.15) }
763:       p.pos.y = gh
764:       p.vel.y = 0
765:       p.grounded = true
766:     } else if (p.pos.y > gh + 0.02) p.grounded = false
767:     if (p.grounded) {
768:       const g2 = this.world.groundHeightAt(p.pos.x, p.pos.z)
769:       if (g2 <= p.pos.y + 0.52 && g2 >= p.pos.y - 0.55) p.pos.y = g2
770:       else if (g2 < p.pos.y - 0.55) p.grounded = false
771:     }
772:     this.world.boundsClamp(p.pos, radius)
773: 
774:     // bob + footsteps
775:     p.speed = Math.hypot(p.vel.x, p.vel.z)
776:     const moving = p.speed > 0.8
777:     if (moving && p.grounded) {
778:       const rate = wantSprint ? 11.5 : 8.2
779:       p.stepPhase += dt * rate * clamp(p.speed / 4.7, 0.5, 1.5)
780:       const step = Math.floor(p.stepPhase / Math.PI)
781:       if (step !== this.lastStep) { this.lastStep = step; this.audio.footstep(wantSprint) }
782:     }
783:     p.eye = damp(p.eye, eyeTarget, 10, dt)
784:     const bobAmt = moving && p.grounded ? clamp(p.speed / 7, 0, 1) * (1 - this.weapon.adsAmount * 0.85) : 0
785:     const bobY = Math.sin(p.stepPhase * 2) * 0.035 * bobAmt
786:     const bobX = Math.cos(p.stepPhase) * 0.022 * bobAmt
787:     const strafeRoll = clamp((r * -1) * 0.02 + (this.mouseDX * 0.000015), -0.04, 0.04)
788:     this.mouseDX = 0; this.mouseDY = 0
789: 
790:     const recoil = this.weapon.consumeRecoil()
791:     this.recoilAccum.x += recoil.pitch
792:     this.recoilAccum.y += recoil.yaw
793:     this.recoilAccum.x = damp(this.recoilAccum.x, 0, 9, dt)
794:     this.recoilAccum.y = damp(this.recoilAccum.y, 0, 9, dt)
795: 
796:     this.shake = Math.max(0, this.shake - dt * 2.8)
797:     const shakeAmt = this.shake * 0.011
798:     const shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmt
799:     const shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmt
800:     const shakeRoll = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmt * 0.9
801:     this.camera.position.set(
802:       p.pos.x + bobX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shake * 0.018,
803:       p.pos.y + p.eye + bobY,
804:       p.pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shake * 0.018
805:     )
806:     this.camera.rotation.set(
807:       p.pitch + this.recoilAccum.x + shakeX,
808:       p.yaw + this.recoilAccum.y + shakeY,
809:       strafeRoll + shakeRoll
810:     )
811:     p.cameraPos.copy(this.camera.position)
812: 
813:     // health regen
814:     if (this.time - p.lastDamage > 6 && p.health < 100 && this.mode === 'playing') {
815:       p.health = Math.min(100, p.health + 11 * dt)
816:     }
817: 
818:     const input = {
819:       time: this.time, speed: p.speed, sprinting: wantSprint, crouch: p.crouching,
820:       grounded: p.grounded, adsHeld: ads, fireHeld: this.fireHeld,
821:       mouseDX: this.mouseDX, mouseDY: this.mouseDY, moving,
822:     }
823:     this.weapon.adsHeld = ads
824:     this.weapon.update(dt, input)
825:     this.weapon.camera.fov = this.weapon.currentFov + (wantSprint ? 5 : 0)
826:     this.weapon.camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
827:     this.camera.fov = this.weapon.currentFov + (wantSprint ? 5 : 0)
828:     this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
829: 
830:     if (this.weapon.shotThisFrame) this.shoot()
831:     if (this.weapon.consumeMeleeHit()) this.meleeDamage()
832:   }

834:   shoot() {
835:     const def = this.weapon.def
836:     const origin = new THREE.Vector3().copy(this.camera.position)
837:     this.camera.getWorldDirection(this.forward)
838:     this.right.crossVectors(this.forward, this.up).normalize()
839:     this.tmpV3.crossVectors(this.right, this.forward).normalize()
840:     const spread = this.weapon.getSpread(this.player.speed > 1)
841:     const a = Math.random() * TAU
842:     const rad = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * spread
843:     const dir = this.forward.clone().addScaledVector(this.right, Math.cos(a) * rad).addScaledVector(this.tmpV3, Math.sin(a) * rad).normalize()
844: 
845:     this.raycaster.set(origin, dir)
846:     this.raycaster.far = def.range
847:     const worldHits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.world.raycastTargets, true)
848:     const wHit = worldHits[0]
849:     const eHit = this.enemies.raycast(origin, dir, def.range)
850:     const muzzle = this.camera.position.clone().addScaledVector(this.forward, 0.5).addScaledVector(this.right, 0.13).addScaledVector(this.tmpV3, -0.11)
851:     this.effects.muzzleFlash(muzzle, this.forward, 1)
852:     this.audio.shot(def.kind)
853: 
854:     let end = origin.clone().addScaledVector(dir, def.range)
855:     if (eHit && (!wHit || eHit.distance < wHit.distance)) {
856:       end = eHit.point.clone()
857:       const result = this.enemies.damage(eHit.enemy, def.damage, eHit.zone, eHit.point, dir)
858:       this.hits = (this.hits || 0) + 1
859:       this.weapon.shotsHit++
860:       this.hud.hit(result.dead ? 'kill' : result.headshot ? 'head' : 'body')
861:       this.audio.hit(result.headshot, result.dead)
862:       this.effects.impact(eHit.point, dir.clone().negate(), { metal: false, force: 0.5 })
863:     } else if (wHit) {
864:       end = wHit.point.clone()
865:       let normal = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)
866:       if (wHit.face) normal.copy(wHit.face.normal).transformDirection(wHit.object.matrixWorld).normalize()
867:       this.effects.impact(wHit.point, normal, { metal: Math.random() > 0.5, force: 1 })
868:     }
869:     this.effects.tracer(muzzle, end, 0xffd8a0, 0.72)
870:     this.effects.casing(this.camera.position.clone().addScaledVector(this.right, 0.2).addScaledVector(this.tmpV3, -0.18), this.right)
871:     this.addShake(0.045)
872:   }

923:   updateGrenades(dt) {

925:       const g = this.grenadesLive[i]
926:       g.fuse -= dt
927:       g.vel.y -= 16 * dt
928:       g.mesh.position.addScaledVector(g.vel, dt)
929:       const gh = this.world.groundHeightAt(g.mesh.position.x, g.mesh.position.z)
930:       if (g.mesh.position.y < gh + 0.12) {
931:         g.mesh.position.y = gh + 0.12
932:         if (Math.abs(g.vel.y) > 1) g.vel.y *= -0.45
933:         else g.vel.y = 0
934:         g.vel.x *= 0.7; g.vel.z *= 0.7
935:       }
936:       for (const c of this.world.colliders) {
937:         if (g.mesh.position.x > c.minX - 0.1 && g.mesh.position.x < c.maxX + 0.1 && g.mesh.position.z > c.minZ - 0.1 && g.mesh.position.z < c.maxZ + 0.1 && g.mesh.position.y > c.minY && g.mesh.position.y < c.maxY) {
938:           g.vel.x *= -0.35; g.vel.z *= -0.35
939:         }
940:       }
941:       g.blink += dt
942:       g.ball.material.emissiveIntensity = g.fuse < 0.8 ? (Math.sin(g.blink * 30) > 0 ? 3.5 : 0.1) : 0.5
943:       if (g.fuse <= 0) {
944:         const pos = g.mesh.position.clone()
945:         this.effects.explosion(pos, { radius: 7 })
946:         this.audio.explosion(pos.distanceTo(this.player.pos), 0)
947:         this.addShake(0.5)
948:         const radius = 7.5
949:         for (const e of this.enemies.enemies) {
950:           if (e.dead) continue
951:           const d = e.root.position.distanceTo(pos)
952:           if (d < radius) {
953:             const dmg = 260 * (1 - d / radius)
954:             const point = new THREE.Vector3(e.root.position.x, e.root.position.y + 1.2, e.root.position.z)
955:             this.enemies.damage(e, dmg, 'body', point, point.clone().sub(pos).normalize())
956:           }
957:         }
958:         const pd = this.player.pos.distanceTo(pos)
959:         if (pd < 6.5) this.takeDamage(42 * (1 - pd / 7.5), pos, null)
960:         this.scene.remove(g.mesh)
961:         g.mesh.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.geometry.dispose(); o.material.dispose() } })
962:         this.grenadesLive.splice(i, 1)
963:       }
964:     }

972:   takeDamage(amount, sourcePos, enemy) {
973:     if (this.mode !== 'playing' || amount <= 0) return
974:     const p = this.player
975:     let dmg = amount
976:     if (p.armor > 0) {
977:       const absorb = Math.min(p.armor, dmg * 0.68)
978:       p.armor -= absorb
979:       dmg -= absorb

815:   // ---------- update ----------
816:   const tmpV = new THREE.Vector3(), tmpQ = new THREE.Quaternion(), up = new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0)
817:   function update(dt, time, playerPos) {
818:     skyMat.uniforms.time.value = time
819:     rainMat.uniforms.time.value = time
820:     rainMat.uniforms.playerPos.value.copy(playerPos)
821:     dustMat.uniforms.time.value = time
822: 
823:     if (playerPos) {
824:       // searchlight sweeps
825:       const a = time * 0.17
826:       searchTarget.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 16, 0, Math.sin(a * 0.8 + 1) * 15)
827:       const dir = tmpV.copy(searchTarget.position).sub(searchSpot.position)
828:       const len = dir.length()
829:       dir.normalize()
830:       searchCone.position.copy(searchSpot.position).addScaledVector(dir, len / 2)
831:       tmpQ.setFromUnitVectors(up, dir)
832:       searchCone.quaternion.copy(tmpQ)
833:       searchCone.scale.set(1, len / 48, 1)
834:     }
835: 
836:     for (const b of beacons) {
837:       const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3.2 + b.phase)
838:       if (b.lamp?.material) b.lamp.material.color.setRGB(1, 0.1 + pulse * 0.25, 0.06)
839:       if (b.lamp2?.material) b.lamp2.material.color.setRGB(1, 0.1 + pulse * 0.25, 0.06)
840:       if (b.glow) b.glow.material.opacity = 0.2 + pulse * 0.45
841:     }
842:     for (const f of flickerLights) {
843:       const flick = 0.88 + 0.12 * Math.sin(time * 17 * f.rate + f.phase) * Math.sin(time * 5.3 + f.phase * 2)
844:       f.spot.intensity = f.base * flick
845:       f.cone.material.opacity = 0.026 * flick
846:     }
847:     for (const s of smokeSprites) {
848:       s.sprite.position.y += dt * s.speed
849:       s.sprite.position.x = s.baseX + Math.sin(time * 0.12 + s.phase) * 3
850:       s.sprite.position.z = s.baseZ + Math.cos(time * 0.1 + s.phase) * 3
851:       if (s.sprite.position.y > 60) s.sprite.position.y = 32
852:     }
853:     for (const f of fogSprites) {
854:       f.sprite.position.x += Math.sin(time * 0.04 + f.phase) * dt * f.speed
855:       f.sprite.position.z += Math.cos(time * 0.03 + f.phase) * dt * f.speed
856:     }
857:   }

859:   function groundHeightAt(x, z) {
860:     if (x > platform.minX && x < platform.maxX && z > platform.minZ && z < platform.maxZ) return platform.height
861:     for (const r of platform.ramps) {
862:       if (Math.abs(x - r.x) < r.w / 2 && z >= Math.min(r.z0, r.z1) && z <= Math.max(r.z0, r.z1)) {
863:         const t = (z - r.z0) / (r.z1 - r.z0)
864:         return platform.height * (1 - t)
865:       }
866:     }
867:     return 0

293:     this.reserve = [210, 90]
294:     this.index = 0
295:     this.fireTimer = 0
296:     this.reloadT = 0
297:     this.reloading = false
298:     this.reloadStage = 0
299:     this.switching = false
300:     this.switchT = 0
301:     this.pendingIndex = 0
302:     this.adsHeld = false
303:     this.adsAmount = 0
304:     this.triggerHeld = false
305:     this.lastTrigger = false
306:     this.shotThisFrame = false
307:     this.meleeT = 0
308:     this.meleeCooldown = 0
309:     this.meleeDidHit = false
310:     this.kick = 0
311:     this.kickVel = 0
312:     this.yawKick = 0

335:   triggerDown() {
336:     if (this.switching || this.reloading) return

338:     if (!this.def.auto) this.tryFire()
339:   }
340:   triggerUp() { this.triggerHeld = false }
341: 
342:   setAds(v) { this.adsHeld = v }
343: 
344:   reload() {
345:     if (this.reloading || this.switching) return false
346:     if (this.mag >= this.def.magSize || this.reserveAmmo <= 0) return false
347:     this.reloading = true
348:     this.reloadT = 0
349:     this.reloadStage = 0
350:     this.audio.reloadStep(0)
351:     return true
352:   }
353: 
354:   switchTo(i) {
355:     if (i === this.index || this.switching) return false
356:     if (i < 0 || i >= WEAPONS.length) return false
357:     this.switching = true
358:     this.switchT = 0
359:     this.pendingIndex = i
360:     this.reloading = false
361:     return true
362:   }

364:   nextWeapon() { return this.switchTo((this.index + 1) % WEAPONS.length) }
365: 
366:   tryFire() {
367:     if (this.reloading || this.switching || this.meleeT > 0) return false
368:     if (this.fireTimer > 0) return false
369:     const def = this.def
370:     if (this.ammo[this.index] <= 0) {
371:       this.audio.dryFire()
372:       this.fireTimer = 0.25
373:       this.reload()
374:       return false
375:     }
376:     this.ammo[this.index]--
377:     this.fireTimer = 60 / def.rpm
378:     this.shotsFired++
379:     this.shotThisFrame = true
380:     this.lastShotTime = performance.now() / 1000
381:     const ads = this.adsAmount
382:     const kickScale = ads > 0.5 ? 0.72 : 1
383:     this.kick = 1
384:     this.kickVel = 2.6
385:     this.yawKick = rand(-1, 1) * (ads > 0.5 ? 0.35 : 1)
386:     this.recoilPitch += def.recoil * kickScale
387:     this.recoilYaw += this.yawKick * def.recoilYaw
388:     this.muzzleTime = 0.05
389:     this.audio.shot(def.kind)
390:     return true
391:   }
392: 
393:   melee() {
394:     if (this.meleeCooldown > 0 || this.switching || this.reloading) return false
395:     this.meleeT = 0.5
396:     this.meleeCooldown = 0.9
397:     this.meleeDidHit = false
398:     this.audio.melee()
399:     return true
400:   }
401: 
402:   consumeMeleeHit() {
403:     if (this.meleeT > 0 && this.meleeT < 0.34 && !this.meleeDidHit) {
404:       this.meleeDidHit = true
405:       return true
406:     }
407:     return false
408:   }
409: 
410:   update(dt, input) {
411:     this.shotThisFrame = false
412:     this.triggerHeld = input.fireHeld
413:     this.fireTimer = Math.max(0, this.fireTimer - dt)
414:     this.meleeCooldown = Math.max(0, this.meleeCooldown - dt)
415:     this.muzzleTime = Math.max(0, this.muzzleTime - dt)
416:     this.landKick = Math.max(0, this.landKick - dt * 3)
417: 
418:     const def = this.def
419:     const canAds = !this.reloading && !this.switching && this.meleeT <= 0 && !input.sprinting
420:     const targetAds = this.adsHeld && canAds ? 1 : 0
421:     this.adsAmount = damp(this.adsAmount, targetAds, 12, dt)
422:     this.sprint = damp(this.sprint, input.sprinting ? 1 : 0, 9, dt)
423: 
424:     this.kickVel += (-this.kick * 150 - this.kickVel * 16) * dt
425:     this.kick += this.kickVel * dt
426:     this.kick = clamp(this.kick, 0, 1.6)
427:     this.yawKick = damp(this.yawKick, 0, 8, dt)
428:     this.swayTargetX = clamp(input.mouseDX * 0.00016, -0.03, 0.03)
429:     this.swayTargetY = clamp(input.mouseDY * 0.00016, -0.03, 0.03)
430:     this.swayX = damp(this.swayX, this.swayTargetX, 9, dt)
431:     this.swayY = damp(this.swayY, this.swayTargetY, 9, dt)
432: 
433:     const speedFactor = clamp(input.speed / 7, 0, 1.4)
434:     this.bobPhase += dt * (input.sprinting ? 12.5 : 8.2) * Math.min(1, speedFactor + 0.25)
435:     const bobAmp = speedFactor * (1 - this.adsAmount * 0.82) * (input.grounded ? 1 : 0.3)
436:     const bobX = Math.sin(this.bobPhase) * 0.009 * bobAmp
437:     const bobY = Math.abs(Math.cos(this.bobPhase)) * 0.008 * bobAmp
438: 
439:     // firing
440:     if (input.fireHeld && !this.switching && !this.reloading && this.meleeT <= 0) {
441:       if (def.auto) this.tryFire()
442:       else if (!this.lastTrigger) this.tryFire()
443:     }
444:     this.lastTrigger = input.fireHeld
445:     if (input.fireHeld && this.ammo[this.index] === 0 && !this.reloading && !this.switching) this.reload()
446: 
447:     // reload timeline
448:     if (this.reloading) {
449:       this.reloadT += dt
450:       const t = this.reloadT / def.reloadTime
451:       if (t > 0.18 && this.reloadStage === 0) { this.reloadStage = 1; this.audio.reloadStep(1) }
452:       if (t > 0.66 && this.reloadStage === 1) { this.reloadStage = 2; this.audio.reloadStep(2) }
453:       if (t > 0.86 && this.reloadStage === 2) { this.reloadStage = 3; this.audio.reloadStep(3) }
454:       if (t >= 1) {
455:         const need = def.magSize - this.ammo[this.index]
456:         const take = Math.min(need, this.reserveAmmo)
457:         this.ammo[this.index] += take
458:         this.reserve[this.index] -= take
459:         this.reloading = false
460:         this.reloadStage = 0
461:         this.reloadT = 0
462:       }
463:     }
464: 
465:     // switching
466:     if (this.switching) {
467:       this.switchT += dt
468:       if (this.switchT > 0.24 && this.pendingIndex !== this.index) {
469:         this.index = this.pendingIndex
470:         this.audio.reloadStep(3)
471:       }
472:       if (this.switchT > 0.56) { this.switching = false; this.switchT = 0 }
473:     }
474: 
475:     if (this.meleeT > 0) this.meleeT = Math.max(0, this.meleeT - dt)
476:     if (this.meleeT > 0.26) this.knife.visible = true
477:     else this.knife.visible = false
478: 
479:     // model placement
480:     for (let i = 0; i < this.models.length; i++) {
481:       const model = this.models[i]
482:       model.visible = i === this.index && this.visible
483:       if (!model.visible) continue
484:       const isRifle = i === 0
485:       const hip = isRifle ? new THREE.Vector3(0.205, -0.235, -0.52) : new THREE.Vector3(0.2, -0.245, -0.5)
486:       const ads = isRifle ? new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.072, -0.435) : new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.077, -0.4)
487:       const base = hip.clone().lerp(ads, this.adsAmount)
488:       const reloadCurve = this.reloading ? Math.sin(clamp(this.reloadT / def.reloadTime, 0, 1) * Math.PI) : 0
489:       const switchCurve = this.switching ? Math.sin(clamp(this.switchT / 0.56, 0, 1) * Math.PI) : 0
490:       const k = this.kick
491:       base.x += this.swayX * (1 - this.adsAmount * 0.8) + bobX + (this.adsAmount < 0.5 ? this.sprint * 0.025 : 0)
492:       base.y += this.swayY * (1 - this.adsAmount * 0.8) - bobY - reloadCurve * 0.055 - switchCurve * 0.28 + this.sprint * -0.025 - this.landKick * 0.02
493:       base.z += k * 0.055 + reloadCurve * 0.02
494:       model.position.copy(base)
495:       const recoilTilt = k * 0.055
496:       const rotX = (isRifle ? 0.02 : 0.02) + this.swayY * 0.6 + recoilTilt + reloadCurve * -0.5 + switchCurve * 0.35
497:       const rotY = (isRifle ? -0.025 : -0.03) * (1 - this.adsAmount) + this.swayX * 0.8 + this.yawKick * 0.018
498:       const rotZ = 0.015 + this.swayX * 0.9 + reloadCurve * -0.6 + this.sprint * -0.16 + switchCurve * 0.8
499:       model.rotation.set(rotX, rotY, rotZ)
500: 
501:       const ud = model.userData
502:       if (ud.mag) {
503:         const md = this.reloading ? Math.max(0, Math.sin(clamp((this.reloadT / def.reloadTime - 0.12) / 0.52, 0, 1) * Math.PI)) : 0
504:         ud.mag.position.y = ud.magBaseY - md * 0.24
505:         ud.mag.rotation.z = md * 0.5
506:       }
507:       if (ud.leftHand) {
508:         const lh = this.reloading ? Math.sin(clamp(this.reloadT / def.reloadTime, 0, 1) * Math.PI) : 0
509:         ud.leftHand.position.y = -0.09 - lh * 0.08
510:         ud.leftHand.position.z = -0.38 + lh * 0.26
511:       }
512:       if (ud.flash) {
513:         ud.flash.material.opacity = this.muzzleTime > 0 ? rand(0.7, 1) : 0
514:         ud.flash.material.rotation = rand(0, 6.28)
515:         ud.flash.scale.setScalar(rand(0.28, 0.42))
516:       }
517:       if (ud.flashLight) ud.flashLight.intensity = this.muzzleTime > 0 ? 3 : 0
518:       if (ud.dot) {
519:         const target = this.adsAmount > 0.65 ? 0.014 : 0.01
520:         ud.dot.scale.setScalar(damp(ud.dot.scale.x, target, 8, dt))
521:         ud.dot.material.opacity = this.adsAmount > 0.5 ? 0.95 : 0.55
522:       }
523:     }
524: 
525:     // knife slash
526:     if (this.knife.visible) {
527:       const t = 1 - this.meleeT / 0.5
528:       const slash = Math.sin(t * Math.PI)
529:       this.knife.position.set(0.3 - slash * 0.45, -0.26 + slash * 0.08, -0.38 - slash * 0.15)
530:       this.knife.rotation.set(0.1 + slash * 0.6, -0.35 - slash * 0.8, -0.2 + slash * 1.6)
531:       this.knife.scale.setScalar(1)
532:     }
533: 
534:     // fov
535:     this.currentFov = lerp(this.baseFov, def.adsFov, this.adsAmount)
536:     this.camera.fov = this.currentFov
537:     this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
538:   }

15:   c.width = c.height = size

19: function tex(c, { srgb = false, repeat = 1, aniso = 4 } = {}) {
20:   const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
21:   t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
22:   t.repeat.set(repeat, repeat)
23:   t.anisotropy = aniso
24:   if (srgb) t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
25:   t.needsUpdate = true
26:   return t
27: }

29: function noiseFill(ctx, size, base, variance, rng) {
30:   const img = ctx.createImageData(size, size)
31:   const d = img.data
32:   for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
33:     const n = (rng() - 0.5) * variance
34:     d[i] = base[0] + n
35:     d[i + 1] = base[1] + n
36:     d[i + 2] = base[2] + n
37:     d[i + 3] = 255
38:   }
39:   ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0)
40: }

42: function blotches(ctx, size, rng, count, colors, minR, maxR, alpha) {
43:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
44:     const x = rng() * size, y = rng() * size
45:     const r = minR + rng() * (maxR - minR)
46:     const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r)
47:     const c = colors[Math.floor(rng() * colors.length)]
48:     g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},${alpha})`)
49:     g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},0)`)
50:     ctx.fillStyle = g
51:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
52:   }
53: }

55: function cracks(ctx, size, rng, count, color, width = 1) {
56:   ctx.lineCap = 'round'
57:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
58:     let x = rng() * size, y = rng() * size
59:     let a = rng() * Math.PI * 2
60:     ctx.strokeStyle = color
61:     ctx.lineWidth = width * (0.5 + rng())
62:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y)
63:     const steps = 5 + Math.floor(rng() * 14)
64:     for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
65:       a += (rng() - 0.5) * 1.3
66:       x += Math.cos(a) * (3 + rng() * 10)
67:       y += Math.sin(a) * (3 + rng() * 10)
68:       ctx.lineTo(x, y)
69:     }
70:     ctx.stroke()
71:   }
72: }

74: function normalFromHeight(heightCanvas, strength = 2.2) {
75:   const size = heightCanvas.width
76:   const hctx = heightCanvas.getContext('2d')
77:   const src = hctx.getImageData(0, 0, size, size).data
78:   const out = canvas(size)
79:   const octx = out.getContext('2d')
80:   const img = octx.createImageData(size, size)
81:   const d = img.data
82:   const at = (x, y) => {
83:     x = (x + size) % size; y = (y + size) % size
84:     return src[(y * size + x) * 4] / 255
85:   }
86:   for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
87:     for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
88:       const dx = (at(x + 1, y) - at(x - 1, y)) * strength
89:       const dy = (at(x, y + 1) - at(x, y - 1)) * strength
90:       let nx = -dx, ny = -dy, nz = 1
91:       const l = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz)
92:       nx /= l; ny /= l; nz /= l
93:       const i = (y * size + x) * 4
94:       d[i] = (nx * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255
95:       d[i + 1] = (ny * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255
96:       d[i + 2] = (nz * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255
97:       d[i + 3] = 255
98:     }
99:   }
100:   octx.putImageData(img, 0, 0)
101:   return out
102: }

104: export function concreteTextures(seed = 7, size = 512) {

109:   blotches(ac, size, rng, 34, [[42, 45, 46], [100, 103, 100], [60, 64, 64], [110, 108, 100]], 20, 110, 0.16)
110:   cracks(ac, size, rng, 15, 'rgba(25,28,28,.55)', 1.2)

114:     const w = 2 + rng() * 9, h = 30 + rng() * 160

174: export function metalTextures(base = [68, 76, 78], seed = 21, corrugated = true, size = 512) {

181:   for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
182:     const x = rng() * size, y = rng() * size, h = 20 + rng() * 180
183:     const g = ac.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h)
184:     g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(90,48,24,${0.08 + rng() * 0.22})`)
185:     g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(90,48,24,0)')

187:     rc.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,60,60,.2)'; rc.fillRect(x, y, 2 + rng() * 8, h)

189:   for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
190:     const x = rng() * size, y = rng() * size
191:     ac.strokeStyle = `rgba(180,188,188,${0.05 + rng() * 0.18})`
192:     ac.lineWidth = 0.5 + rng()
193:     ac.beginPath(); ac.moveTo(x, y); ac.lineTo(x + (rng() - 0.5) * 40, y + (rng() - 0.5) * 8); ac.stroke()
194:   }

203:       hc.fillRect(x, 0, 1, size)
204:     }
205:     for (let y = 0; y < size; y += 64) {

212:     ac.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,34,35,.55)'; ac.beginPath(); ac.arc(x, y, 2.2, 0, 7); ac.fill()
213:     ac.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,158,158,.25)'; ac.beginPath(); ac.arc(x - .6, y - .6, 1.1, 0, 7); ac.fill()
214:   }
215:   return {
216:     map: tex(albedo, { srgb: true, repeat: 1 }),
217:     roughnessMap: tex(rough),
218:     normalMap: tex(normalFromHeight(height, corrugated ? 3.2 : 1.1)),
219:   }

**ZERO HOUR is complete and committed** (`32430d2`).

## What changed

- **Fixed both arena ramps** — corrected ramp orientation/descriptors and rebuilt them as proper sloped geometry with matching side rails; platform access now works from both sides.
- **Fixed mouse look/sway input** — look deltas are captured before reset, so weapon sway no longer loses the last mouse movement.
- **Touch mode fixes** — no pointer-lock request on touch devices, and touch input no longer immediately triggers the pause/unlock path.
- **Tap-to-shoot reliability** — quick taps/clicks now queue a shot so they aren't dropped on low frame rates.
- **Mobile HUD layout** — vitals sit above the joystick and ammo above the touch buttons in portrait; compact landscape layout keeps all HUD elements and buttons clear of each other.
- **Landscape modal fixes** — pause, victory/defeat, and settings cards now fit within short landscape viewports without clipped buttons or stray scrollbars.
- **Favicon** — added an inline SVG favicon, removing the 404.

## Verified

Tested in Chromium at desktop `1280×800`, portrait `390×844`, and landscape `844×390`:

- Menu → gameplay → pause → resume
- Restart and abort-to-menu
- Victory and defeat results, retry, and return-to-menu
- Touch joystick movement, touch fire/reload/jump buttons
- Wave 1 spawning, firing, reload, damage, and ramp traversal
- Console: **0 errors, 0 warnings**; no failed requests

Verification screenshots are in `screenshots/` (gitignored).

## Run it

From the repository root:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
```

Then open `http://localhost:3002/`.

## Assumptions / limitations

- It runs as a static site with no build step, so it must be served over HTTP rather than opened via `file://`.
- Browser testing used software rendering (SwiftShader/llvmpipe), so real-device frame rates weren’t measured.
- Audio starts after the first user interaction, as required by browser autoplay policies.
